<?php
class ProducerBase225 { private static function capture($saved,$ignored) { echo "PRIVATE;"; return $saved; } public static function run() { global $argument,$owner; echo "FIRST;"; return $owner->MiSsInG((\Closure::fromCallable(["ProducerChild225","capture"]))($argument,shift225())); } }
class ProducerChild225 extends ProducerBase225 { public static function capture($saved,$ignored) { echo "PRODUCER:",self::class,":",static::class,";"; return $saved; } }
function shift225() { $GLOBALS["argument"]=new New225; $GLOBALS["owner"]=null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; }
class Old225 { public function __destruct() { echo "OLD;"; } } class New225 { public function __destruct() { echo "NEW;"; } }
class Magic225 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { $GLOBALS["argument"]=null; echo "HANDLER:",($arguments[0] instanceof Old225)?"OLD;":"BAD;"; return false; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$argument=new Old225; $owner=new Magic225; $result=ProducerBase225::run(); echo "RETURN;"; echo $result===false?"AFTER;":"BAD;";

<?php
class Zero225 { public static function capture() { echo "ZERO;"; return 7; } }
class MagicZero225 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo ($arguments[0]===1 && $arguments[1]===7)?"HANDLER;":"BAD;"; return false; } }
$owner=new MagicZero225; $result=$owner->MiSsInG(1,(\Closure::fromCallable(["Zero225","capture"]))()); echo "RETURN;"; echo $result===false?"AFTER;":"BAD;";
